ABOUT US Established in January 2010, Freedom Performing Arts is an independent school offering a variety of different classes in all areas of performing arts. Freedom have become one of the leading Performing Arts Schools in the Knaresborough area, boasting over 230 Students aged 3yrs – 18yrs of age. Created and founded by Amy Meikle, the school aims to provide fun classes that allow you to express yourself and have fun, as well as learning good technique and improving your confidence. Here at Freedom we believe that children learn best whilst having fun and being with their friends in an environment where there the students simply have the FREEDOM to be themselves. ​ All our teachers have trained professionally at various colleges across the country and have vast experience working within the industry. Go to our "TEACHERS" page for more details. ​ All of our classes are held at Aspin Park Academy in Knaresborough.
